newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open unchanged.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open unchanged.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open unchanged Tuesday although the LME backwardation weakened further overnight.
The cash to three months LME backwardation was at $60/$65, down some $20 since the close Monday, a day when the spread halved from Friday's $200 level.
COMEX July copper last traded at 109.75 cents a lb on ACCESS, down 0.45 cent from Monday's close, traded 110.20 to 109.75 cents.
LME warehouse copper stocks fell 725 tonnes Tuesday to 141,075 tonnes, while COMEX stocks rose 193 short tons Monday to 52,120 short tons.
A union official at Escondida mine in Chile where a small group of workers have been on strike for over a week, said the mine has contracted temporary workers to try and make up for lost output.
